frontend-creator.description: Scaffolds and updates self-contained React 19 frontend features, pages, modals, and forms following project conventions and Convex hooks.

convex-domain.description: Scaffolds and updates Convex backend domains enforcing strict Zod v4 validation, zodOutputToConvex schemas, zid helpers, and trigger-backed mutations.

convex-db-assistant.description: Manages Convex database schema design, relational indexes, triggers, sharded counters, and database seeding across backend domains.

convex-architect.description: Universal Convex architect agent for modular backend domains, Zod v4 validation, zodOutputToConvex schemas, custom query/mutation wrappers, relational triggers, and sharded counters.
